connector.name: Colber MCP
connector.registryDescription: Trust + coordination infrastructure for the agent economy. 27 tools across 6 Colber modules.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the obi49 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: COLBER_BASE_URLS
env.description: Optional JSON map of Colber service base URLs. Defaults to local ports 14001/14011/14021/14031/14041/14051. For the hosted Colber API, use api.colber.dev path-based URLs.

env.name: COLBER_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token forwarded to the backend services. Leave empty for unauthenticated local development.

env.name: COLBER_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: pino log level for stderr output (stdout is reserved for MCP JSON-RPC). One of: trace, debug, info, warn, error. Defaults to info.
